steps.intent: Use observer-relative senses, exact origin, real language/hearing/knowledge and distance. Do not grant global sight or invented NPC information.

loot.settlement: No generic post-combat payment established by the reachable-item trace. Do not duplicate campaign boss/room rewards.

source_differences: SRD Web is DEX saveDC13, Recharge5–6 and an actual AC10/HP5 destructible web; Crown Web is a native hit attack plus STR restraintDC12, and Bite uses a separate poison save.

retained_runtime_observations.boundary: Read-only code observation, not gameplay verification: after a hit poison_save/restrain/paralyze_save call saving_throw_to_dc and add_condition with max(1,duration) turn count; corrode_armor adds AC-1 modifier for duration default10 rather than damaging a carried armor copy. reduce_max_hp uses existing damage receipt and direct maxHP mutation. Do not treat these simplified interpretations as source rules or replace them here.
